title: Canonical complete-affine sections limit of a coherent module
statement: Let $A$ be Noetherian, complete for $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and let $J$ be the ideal sheaf of $I$ on $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$. For any coherent module $H$ on $S$ [pqf-def-coherent], there is an $A$-linear isomorphism $s:\Gamma(S,H)\simeq\varprojlim_n\Gamma(S,H/J^{n+1}H)$ whose composite with every projection is $\Gamma(\pi^H_{n+1})$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module].

proof.text: Apply globalSections_formalFunctions_complete_base to the proper identity of Spec A and H. Rewrite ideal-sheaf comap_id. The globalSectionsFunctor followed by restriction along GammaSpecIso inverse and appTop of the identity is definitionally moduleSpecGammaFunctor; explicitly prove this functor equality by rfl and rewrite the existential theorem. Its isomorphism and projection equations give precisely the assertion.

theorem affine_complete_coherent_sections
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom))
    (H : CoherentModules (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))) :
    ∃ e : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).obj H.obj ≅
        limit (formalCompletionSystem J H.obj ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)),
      ∀ n : ℕ, e.hom ≫ limit.π
          (formalCompletionSystem J H.obj ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A))
          (op n) =
        (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).map
          (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) H.obj)
